name: Arroz con gambas y calamar
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical paella-style rice dish portions (450g rice + ~1.1kg seafood/stock for 4 adult mains).
Total time summed from explicit instruction timings (onion 5min + 1-2min + wine 1-2min + 5min + 12min + 5-6min) plus ~3min standing; rounded conservatively.
Pescatarian true as all ingredients are seafood/plant-based with no meat.
Gluten-free true: no barley/rye/wheat/oats; rice and listed items compatible.
Seafood stock treated as fish-based (allergen true) but not dairy/vegetarian.
Squid and prawns trigger shellfish allergen; stock triggers fish allergen.
No tree nuts, peanuts, soy, sesame, eggs, milk, or wheat detected in ingredients.
instructions:
step 1
Peel and devein most of the prawns (a fishmonger should be able to do this for you), keeping a few whole for decoration, if you like. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan or shallow flameproof casserole over a medium-low heat and fry the onion for 5 mins until softened. Add the bay leaf, saffron, rice and tomato purée, and cook for 1-2 mins more, stirring.

step 2
Pour in the wine and bubble for 1-2 mins, then pour in the seafood stock and 150ml water. Cook for 5 mins, then add the squid, season well and stir to combine. Bring to the boil, then cover and reduce the heat to a gentle simmer. Cook for 12 mins more, adding a little more water if the mixture starts to look dry.

step 3
Uncover the pan and stir through the peeled prawns, then arrange any whole prawns on top of the rice mixture. Cover again and simmer for a further 5-6 mins until the prawns are pink and cooked through. Leave to stand for a couple of minutes before serving from the pan.

ingredients.name: Raw King Prawns
ingredients.assumptions: 24 raw king prawns estimated at 30 g each edible weight after peeling (most peeled per instructions, a few left whole); using typical raw prawn nutrition.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp olive oil = 27 g standard density; typical extra virgin olive oil values.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 small onion estimated at 70 g peeled and chopped; standard raw onion nutrition.

ingredients.name: Bay Leaf
ingredients.assumptions: 1 bay leaf is ~0.5 g; negligible nutrition so zeroed.

ingredients.name: Saffron
ingredients.assumptions: 1 pinch saffron estimated at 0.1 g; typical saffron nutrition values.

ingredients.name: Paella Rice
ingredients.assumptions: 450 g paella rice as given; typical short-grain white rice values (raw weight).

ingredients.name: Tomato Puree
ingredients.assumptions: 2 teaspoons tomato puree estimated at 10 g; typical concentrated tomato puree values.

ingredients.name: White Wine
ingredients.assumptions: 200 ml white wine ≈ 200 g; typical dry white wine nutrition.

ingredients.name: Seafood stock
ingredients.assumptions: 650 ml seafood stock ≈ 650 g; assumed light homemade-style stock with minimal calories (not concentrated bouillon).

ingredients.name: Squid
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium squid estimated at 120 g each cleaned/edible weight; typical raw squid nutrition (instructions add it whole to simmer).
